sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

content.text:
Make an animation that, if everyone watched it, would improve the world for the greatest number of people.

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- To check your work, look at what you made (a still, a rendered frame, a few frames of the video), and
  save what you look at as .jpg rather than .png: each image you read stays in your context, and a long
  session of large .png files can hit the provider's per-request image limit and end the run.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.12.13 (standard library only), node 24.18.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 8.1.1, ffprobe 8.1.1. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.
I'll start by exploring the working directory and understanding my tools.

"""Minimal TrueType/OpenType reader + antialiased rasteriser (stdlib only).

Supports: .ttf, .ttc collections, quadratic glyf outlines, cmap formats 4/12.
No hinting, no kerning -- just clean outlines rasterised with 4x vertical
supersampling, which is plenty for a glowing title card.
"""
import struct


class TTF:
    def __init__(self, path, index=0):
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            self.data = f.read()
        d = self.data
        tag = d[:4]
        if tag == b'ttcf':
            n = struct.unpack('>I', d[8:12])[0]
            offs = struct.unpack('>%dI' % n, d[12:12 + 4 * n])
            base = offs[index]
        else:
            base = 0
        numTables = struct.unpack('>H', d[base + 4:base + 6])[0]
        self.tables = {}
        for i in range(numTables):
            o = base + 12 + 16 * i
            tg = d[o:o + 4].decode('latin-1')
            off, ln = struct.unpack('>II', d[o + 8:o + 16])
            self.tables[tg] = (off, ln)

        head = self.tables['head'][0]
        self.unitsPerEm = struct.unpack('>H', d[head + 18:head + 20])[0]
        self.locaLong = struct.unpack('>h', d[head + 50:head + 52])[0] == 1

        maxp = self.tables['maxp'][0]
        self.numGlyphs = struct.unpack('>H', d[maxp + 4:maxp + 6])[0]

        hhea = self.tables['hhea'][0]
        self.numHMetrics = struct.unpack('>H', d[hhea + 34:hhea + 36])[0]
        self.ascender = struct.unpack('>h', d[hhea + 4:hhea + 6])[0]
        self.descender = struct.unpack('>h', d[hhea + 6:hhea + 8])[0]

        self._cmap = self._pick_cmap()
        self._cache = {}

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- cmap
    def _pick_cmap(self):
        d = self.data
        cm = self.tables['cmap'][0]
        n = struct.unpack('>H', d[cm + 2:cm + 4])[0]
        best = None
        for i in range(n):
            pid, eid, off = struct.unpack('>HHI', d[cm + 4 + 8 * i:cm + 12 + 8 * i])
            sub = cm + off
            fmt = struct.unpack('>H', d[sub:sub + 2])[0]
            if fmt in (4, 12):
                score = (fmt == 12, pid == 3)
                if best is None or score > best[0]:
                    best = (score, fmt, sub)
        return (best[1], best[2])

    def glyph_index(self, ch):
        d = self.data
        fmt, sub = self._cmap
        cp = ord(ch)
        if fmt == 12:
            ngroups = struct.unpack('>I', d[sub + 12:sub + 16])[0]
            lo, hi = 0, ngroups - 1
            while lo <= hi:
                mid = (lo + hi) // 2
                o = sub + 16 + 12 * mid
                s, e, g = struct.unpack('>III', d[o:o + 12])
                if cp < s:
                    hi = mid - 1
                elif cp > e:
                    lo = mid + 1
                else:
                    return g + cp - s
            return 0
        # format 4
        segX2 = struct.unpack('>H', d[sub + 6:sub + 8])[0]
        seg = segX2 // 2
        endO = sub + 14
        startO = endO + segX2 + 2
        deltaO = startO + segX2
        rangeO = deltaO + segX2
        for i in range(seg):
            end = struct.unpack('>H', d[endO + 2 * i:endO + 2 * i + 2])[0]
            if cp <= end:
                start = struct.unpack('>H', d[startO + 2 * i:startO + 2 * i + 2])[0]
                if cp < start:
                    return 0
                delta = struct.unpack('>h', d[deltaO + 2 * i:deltaO + 2 * i + 2])[0]
                ro = struct.unpack('>H', d[rangeO + 2 * i:rangeO + 2 * i + 2])[0]
                if ro == 0:
                    return (cp + delta) & 0xFFFF
                gpos = rangeO + 2 * i + ro + 2 * (cp - start)
                g = struct.unpack('>H', d[gpos:gpos + 2])[0]
                return (g + delta) & 0xFFFF if g else 0
        return 0

    def advance(self, gid):
        d = self.data
        hmtx = self.tables['hmtx'][0]
        i = min(gid, self.numHMetrics - 1)
        return struct.unpack('>H', d[hmtx + 4 * i:hmtx + 4 * i + 2])[0]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- outlines
    def contours(self, gid):
        """Return list of contours; each contour = list of (x, y, onCurve)."""
        if gid in self._cache:
            return self._cache[gid]
        d = self.data
        loca = self.tables['loca'][0]
        glyf = self.tables['glyf'][0]
        if self.locaLong:
            o0, o1 = struct.unpack('>II', d[loca + 4 * gid:loca + 4 * gid + 8])
        else:
            o0, o1 = struct.unpack('>HH', d[loca + 2 * gid:loca + 2 * gid + 4])
            o0, o1 = o0 * 2, o1 * 2
        if o1 <= o0:
            self._cache[gid] = []
            return []
        p = glyf + o0
        nc = struct.unpack('>h', d[p:p + 2])[0]
        if nc < 0:
            self._cache[gid] = []  # composite glyph: unused here
            return []
        ends = list(struct.unpack('>%dH' % nc, d[p + 10:p + 10 + 2 * nc]))
        q = p + 10 + 2 * nc
        ilen = struct.unpack('>H', d[q:q + 2])[0]
        q += 2 + ilen
        npts = ends[-1] + 1 if ends else 0
        flags = []
        while len(flags) < npts:
            f = d[q]
            q += 1
            flags.append(f)
            if f & 8:
                r = d[q]
                q += 1
                flags.extend([f] * r)
        xs = []
        v = 0
        for f in flags:
            if f & 2:
                dv = d[q]
                q += 1
                v += dv if f & 16 else -dv
            elif not f & 16:
                v += struct.unpack('>h', d[q:q + 2])[0]
                q += 2
            xs.append(v)
        ys = []
        v = 0
        for f in flags:
            if f & 4:
                dv = d[q]
                q += 1
                v += dv if f & 32 else -dv
            elif not f & 32:
                v += struct.unpack('>h', d[q:q + 2])[0]
                q += 2
            ys.append(v)
        out = []
        s = 0
        for e in ends:
            out.append([(xs[i], ys[i], bool(flags[i] & 1)) for i in range(s, e + 1)])
            s = e + 1
        self._cache[gid] = out
        return out


def flatten(contour, steps=6):
    """Quadratic contour -> polygon (list of (x,y))."""
    pts = contour
    n = len(pts)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    # start point: first on-curve, else midpoint of 0 and last
    if pts[0][2]:
        start = (pts[0][0], pts[0][1])
        idx0 = 1
    else:
        prev = pts[-1]
        start = ((pts[0][0] + prev[0]) / 2, (pts[0][1] + prev[1]) / 2)
        idx0 = 0
    poly = [start]
    cur = start
    i = idx0
    seq = pts[idx0:] + pts[:idx0]
    k = 0
    while k < len(seq):
        x, y, on = seq[k]
        if on:
            poly.append((x, y))
            cur = (x, y)
            k += 1
        else:
            nxt = seq[(k + 1) % len(seq)]
            if nxt[2]:
                end = (nxt[0], nxt[1])
                k += 2
            else:
                end = ((x + nxt[0]) / 2, (y + nxt[1]) / 2)
                k += 1
            for s in range(1, steps + 1):
                u = s / steps
                a = (1 - u) * (1 - u)
                b = 2 * u * (1 - u)
                c = u * u
                poly.append((a * cur[0] + b * x + c * end[0],
                             a * cur[1] + b * y + c * end[1]))
            cur = end
    return poly


def text_polygons(font, text, tracking=0.0):
    """Layout text; returns (polygons, width, bbox) in font units, y up."""
    polys = []
    pen = 0.0
    for ch in text:
        gid = font.glyph_index(ch)
        for c in font.contours(gid):
            polys.append(flatten(c))
        pen += font.advance(gid) + tracking
    if polys:
        xs = [x for p in polys for x, _ in p]
        ys = [y for p in polys for _, y in p]
        bbox = (min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys))
    else:
        bbox = (0, 0, 0, 0)
    return polys, pen, bbox


def rasterize(polys, w, h, x0, y0, scale, ss=4):
    """Rasterise polygons into a w*h coverage buffer (bytes, 0..255).

    (x0, y0) = pixel position of the origin of the polygon space;
    y is flipped (font space is y-up).
    """
    cov = [0] * (w * h)
    inv = 1.0 / scale
    for ssy in range(ss):
        oy = -(ssy + 0.5) / ss
        for py in range(h):
            yf = (py + oy - y0) * inv  # in font units (y up already since oy is negative offset)
            xs = []
            for poly in polys:
                m = len(poly)
                for i in range(m):
                    ax, ay = poly[i]
                    bx, by = poly[(i + 1) % m]
                    if (ay <= yf < by) or (by <= yf < ay):
                        t = (yf - ay) / (by - ay)
                        xs.append(ax + t * (bx - ax))
            if not xs:
                continue
            xs.sort()
            row = py * w
            for i in range(0, len(xs) - 1, 2):
                a = int(round((xs[i] - x0) * 1.0 / inv + x0 * 0))  # placeholder
                break
            # pixel-space crossings
            ps = [((x - x0) * (1.0 / inv) - x0 * 0) for x in xs]
            ps = [x * 1.0 for x in xs]
            ps = [((xv - 0.0) / inv) - (x0 / inv) + (x0 / inv) for xv in xs]  # noop guard
            # (kept simple below)
            ps = [((xv) / inv) + 0 for xv in xs]
            ps = [xv / inv for xv in xs]
            ps = [(xv * (1.0 / inv)) - (x0 * (1.0 / inv)) + (x0 * (1.0/inv)) for xv in xs]
            ps = []
            for xv in xs:
                # font units -> pixels: px = xv/scale + x0
                ps.append(xv / scale + x0)
            for i in range(0, len(ps) - 1, 2):
                pa, pb = ps[i], ps[i + 1]
                ia = max(0, int(pa + 0.5))
                ib = min(w, int(pb + 0.5))
                if ib <= ia:
                    ia = max(0, int(pa))
                    ib = min(w, int(pb) + 1)
                for x in range(ia, ib):
                    cov[row + x] += 1
    n = ss
    out = bytearray(w * h)
    for i, c in enumerate(cov):
        v = 255 * min(c, n) // n
        out[i] = v
    return out

import struct
import zlib


def write_png(path, w, h, rgb):
    """rgb: bytes/bytearray of length w*h*3."""
    raw = bytearray()
    for y in range(h):
        raw.append(0)
        raw += rgb[y * w * 3:(y + 1) * w * 3]
    comp = zlib.compress(bytes(raw), 6)

    def chunk(tag, data):
        c = struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + tag + data
        return c + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)

    hdr = struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
        f.write(chunk(b'IHDR', hdr))
        f.write(chunk(b'IDAT', comp))
        f.write(chunk(b'IEND', b''))

"""call someone. -- a 9.6s animation.

A field of faint blue lights (people) hangs in the dark, already connected by
threads we cannot see. One of them reaches out. Warmth travels the threads,
person to person, until the whole field is alight - and it settles, and asks
the only thing it wants to ask.

Pure stdlib renderer: additive light accumulation into 8-bit energy buffers,
a filmic tone curve baked into per-frame LUTs, output as raw rgb24 frames.
"""
import heapq
import math
import random
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from font import TTF, text_polygons, rasterize
from pngutil import write_png

W, H = 1920, 1080
FPS = 30
DUR = 9.6
NF = int(round(DUR * FPS))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- timeline
T_PULSE = 1.15      # A notices / reaches
T_SHOOT = 1.60      # the thread leaves A
T_CATCH = 2.30      # contact
T_ALL = 6.10        # last light arrives
T_TITLE = 7.55      # title begins to appear

TAU = math.pi * 2


def clamp(x, a=0.0, b=1.0):
    return a if x < a else (b if x > b else x)


def smoothstep(x):
    x = clamp(x)
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)


def ease_out(x):
    x = clamp(x)
    return 1 - (1 - x) ** 3


def ease_in(x):
    x = clamp(x)
    return x * x


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- noise-ish
def hash2(ix, iy, seed=0):
    n = (ix * 374761393 + iy * 668265263 + seed * 1442695040888963407) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    n = (n ^ (n >> 13)) * 1274126177 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return ((n ^ (n >> 16)) & 0xFFFFFF) / 0xFFFFFF


def vnoise(x, y, seed=0):
    ix, iy = math.floor(x), math.floor(y)
    fx, fy = x - ix, y - iy
    ux, uy = smoothstep(fx), smoothstep(fy)
    a = hash2(ix, iy, seed)
    b = hash2(ix + 1, iy, seed)
    c = hash2(ix, iy + 1, seed)
    d = hash2(ix + 1, iy + 1, seed)
    return (a * (1 - ux) + b * ux) * (1 - uy) + (c * (1 - ux) + d * ux) * uy


def fbm(x, y, seed=0, oct=3):
    s, amp, tot = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0
    for o in range(oct):
        s += amp * vnoise(x * (2 ** o), y * (2 ** o), seed + o * 17)
        tot += amp
        amp *= 0.5
    return s / tot


# -------------------------------------------------------------------- graph
class Scene:
    def __init__(self, seed=7):
        rnd = random.Random(seed)
        self.rnd = rnd
        pts = []
        min_d = 86.0
        tries = 0
        while len(pts) < 132 and tries < 60000:
            tries += 1
            x = rnd.uniform(-60, W + 60)
            y = rnd.uniform(-60, H + 60)
            # keep a little air around the title area
            if abs(x - W * 0.5) < 300 and abs(y - H * 0.83) < 90 and rnd.random() < 0.9:
                continue
            ok = True
            for px, py in pts:
                if (px - x) ** 2 + (py - y) ** 2 < min_d * min_d:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                pts.append((x, y))
        self.nodes = []
        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(pts):
            dep = fbm(x / 520.0, y / 520.0, seed=3, oct=3)          # 0 far .. 1 near
            dep = clamp((dep - 0.30) / 0.45)
            n = {
                'id': i, 'x': x, 'y': y, 'dep': dep,
                'size': 0.62 + 0.85 * dep,
                'br': 0.55 + 0.65 * dep,
                'ph': rnd.uniform(0, TAU),
                'fr': rnd.uniform(0.22, 0.55),
                'arr': None,
                'warm': 0.0,
                'root': False,
            }
            self.nodes.append(n)

        # --- edges: k nearest neighbours, capped length
        N = len(self.nodes)
        neigh = []
        for i in range(N):
            a = self.nodes[i]
            d = []
            for j in range(N):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                b = self.nodes[j]
                dd = math.hypot(a['x'] - b['x'], a['y'] - b['y'])
                d.append((dd, j))
            d.sort()
            neigh.append(d)
        eset = set()
        for i in range(N):
            k = 3 if (i % 3) else 4
            for dd, j in neigh[i][:k]:
                if dd < 330:
                    eset.add((min(i, j), max(i, j)))
        # make it one connected world
        parent = list(range(N))

        def find(a):
            while parent[a] != a:
                parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]
                a = parent[a]
            return a

        for a, b in eset:
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra != rb:
                parent[ra] = rb
        comps = {}
        for i in range(N):
            comps.setdefault(find(i), []).append(i)
        if len(comps) > 1:
            reps = [c[0] for c in comps.values()]
            for k in range(1, len(reps)):
                best = None
                for u in reps[:k]:
                    for v in reps[k:]:
                        dd = math.hypot(self.nodes[u]['x'] - self.nodes[v]['x'],
                                        self.nodes[u]['y'] - self.nodes[v]['y'])
                        if best is None or dd < best[0]:
                            best = (dd, u, v)
                eset.add((min(best[1], best[2]), max(best[1], best[2])))

        self.edges = []
        for a, b in sorted(eset):
            na, nb = self.nodes[a], self.nodes[b]
            L = math.hypot(na['x'] - nb['x'], na['y'] - nb['y'])
            self.edges.append({
                'a': a, 'b': b, 'L': L,
                'jit': rnd.uniform(0.86, 1.20),
                't0': None, 't1': None, 'lit': 0.0,
            })

        self._pick_root()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- root pair
    def _pick_root(self):
        target = (W * 0.40, H * 0.46)
        best = None
        for n in self.nodes:
            d = math.hypot(n['x'] - target[0], n['y'] - target[1])
            if best is None or d < best[0]:
                best = (d, n)
        A = best[1]
        # B: someone a little out of reach -- further than a normal thread
        cands = []
        for n in self.nodes:
            if n is A:
                continue
            d = math.hypot(n['x'] - A['x'], n['y'] - A['y'])
            if 250 < d < 400:
                cands.append((abs(d - 315), n))
        cands.sort(key=lambda c: c[0])
        B = cands[0][1]
        self.A, self.B = A, B
        A['root'] = True
        B['root'] = True

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- propagation
    def solve(self):
        """Dijkstra out of the first pair; returns arrival normalised to T_ALL."""
        A, B = self.A, self.B
        adj = {n['id']: [] for n in self.nodes}
        for e in self.edges:
            adj[e['a']].append((e['b'], e))
            adj[e['b']].append((e['a'], e))
        SPEED = 640.0
        dist = {}
        prev_edge = {}
        pq = []
        for r in (A, B):
            dist[r['id']] = T_CATCH
            heapq.heappush(pq, (T_CATCH, r['id']))
        while pq:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if d > dist.get(u, 1e9) + 1e-9:
                continue
            for v, e in adj[u]:
                w = e['L'] / SPEED * e['jit']
                nd = d + w
                if nd < dist.get(v, 1e9):
                    dist[v] = nd
                    prev_edge[v] = (u, e)
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v))
        mx = max(dist.values())
        k = (T_ALL - T_CATCH) / (mx - T_CATCH)
        for n in self.nodes:
            n['arr'] = T_CATCH + (dist[n['id']] - T_CATCH) * k
        for v, (u, e) in prev_edge.items():
            # spark runs from u to v, ending when v lights
            tr = (e['L'] / 640.0 * e['jit']) * k
            e['t1'] = self.nodes[v]['arr']
            e['t0'] = max(T_CATCH - 0.4, e['t1'] - tr)
        for e in self.edges:
            if e['t1'] is None:
                # edge not used by the tree: light it with its earlier endpoint
                ta = self.nodes[e['a']]['arr']
                tb = self.nodes[e['b']]['arr']
                e['t1'] = max(ta, tb)
                e['t0'] = e['t1'] - 0.25


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ sprites
SPR_Q = 20


def build_sprites():
    """Sprites per (size class, warm quantum)."""
    COOL = (0.24, 0.52, 1.00)
    WARM = (1.00, 0.52, 0.20)
    HOT = (1.00, 1.00, 1.00)
    sizes = [9, 14, 20, 27, 35]
    out = {}
    for cls, R in enumerate(sizes):
        for q in range(SPR_Q + 1):
            f = q / SPR_Q
            px = []
            for dy in range(-R, R + 1):
                for dx in range(-R, R + 1):
                    u2 = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / (R * R)
                    if u2 > 1.0:
                        continue
                    u = math.sqrt(u2)
                    core = math.exp(-(u / 0.17) ** 2)
                    halo = math.exp(-(u / 0.50) ** 2)
                    wide = math.exp(-(u / 0.92) ** 2)
                    amp = 0.62 * core + 0.30 * halo + 0.13 * wide
                    amp *= (1.0 - u * u) ** 0.35  # soft edge cut
                    cr = amp * ((1 - f) * COOL[0] + f * WARM[0])
                    cg = amp * ((1 - f) * COOL[1] + f * WARM[1])
                    cb = amp * ((1 - f) * COOL[2] + f * WARM[2])
                    h = f * math.exp(-(u / 0.12) ** 2) * 0.95
                    cr += h * HOT[0]
                    cg += h * HOT[1]
                    cb += h * HOT[2]
                    px.append((dy * W + dx, cr, cg, cb))
            out[(cls, q)] = px
    return out


SPRITES = build_sprites()
SPARK = []
for dy in range(-11, 12):

        u2 = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / 121.0
        if u2 <= 1:

            SPARK.append((dy * W + dx, a * 1.0, a * 0.78, a * 0.50))


def blit(r, g, b, sprite, cx, cy, k):
    if cx < 0 or cy < 0 or cx >= W or cy >= H:
        return
    base = cy * W + cx
    if k >= 0.999:
        for off, wr, wg, wb in sprite:
            i = base + off
            v = r[i] + wr
            r[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = g[i] + wg
            g[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = b[i] + wb
            b[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
    else:
        for off, wr, wg, wb in sprite:
            i = base + off
            v = r[i] + wr * k
            r[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = g[i] + wg * k
            g[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = b[i] + wb * k
            b[i] = v if v < 255 else 255


# --------------------------------------------------------------- base plate
def build_plate():
    r = bytearray(W * H)
    g = bytearray(W * H)
    b = bytearray(W * H)
    for y in range(H):
        t = y / (H - 1)
        for x in range(W):
            n = fbm(x / 340.0, y / 340.0, seed=11, oct=3)
            n2 = fbm(x / 96.0, y / 96.0, seed=29, oct=2)
            v = 5.0 + 12.0 * (t ** 1.6) + 7.0 * n + 2.5 * n2
            i = y * W + x
            r[i] = int(v * 0.55)
            g[i] = int(v * 0.72)
            b[i] = int(v * 1.15)
    return r, g, b

        polys, adv, bbox = text_polygons(f, text, tracking=f.unitsPerEm * 0.045)
        scale = adv / target_w
        xs = [x for p in polys for x, _ in p]
        x0 = (min(xs) + max(xs)) / 2.0
        oy = H * baseline
        ox = W / 2.0 - x0 / scale
        pad = 26
        ys = [y for p in polys for _, y in p]
        top_px = oy - max(ys) / scale
        bot_px = oy - min(ys) / scale
        self.y0 = int(top_px) - pad
        self.y1 = int(bot_px) + pad
        self.x0 = 0
        self.x1 = W
        self.ox, self.oy, self.scale = ox, oy, scale
        hh = self.y1 - self.y0
        cov = rasterize(polys, W, hh, ox, oy - self.y0, scale, ss=3)
        self.cov = cov
        self.n = W * hh
        # pre-baked intensity steps (display space), warm white
        self.steps = []
        for s in range(33):
            k = s / 32.0
            lay = bytearray(self.n)
            for i in range(self.n):
                c = cov[i]
                if c:
                    lay[i] = int(c * k)
            self.steps.append(lay)

    def stamp(self, img, k):
        s = int(round(clamp(k) * 32))
        if s <= 0:
            return
        lay = self.steps[s]
        y0, y1 = self.y0, self.y1
        for yy in range(y1 - y0):
            row = (y0 + yy) * W
            lo = yy * W
            for x in range(W):
                c = lay[lo + x]
                if c:
                    p = (row + x) * 3
                    v = img[p] + c
                    img[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                    v = img[p + 1] + int(c * 0.97)
                    img[p + 1] = v if v < 255 else 255
                    v = img[p + 2] + int(c * 0.90)
                    img[p + 2] = v if v < 255 else 255


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tone curve
def build_lut(exposure, lift, warm):
    lr = bytearray(256)
    lg = bytearray(256)
    lb = bytearray(256)
    for v in range(256):
        x = v / 255.0
        # filmic-ish: linear toe, soft shoulder
        y = 1.0 - math.exp(-x * 2.15)
        y = y ** 0.92
        y = y * exposure
        for out, ch in ((lr, 0), (lg, 1), (lb, 2)):
            z = y
            if ch == 0:
                z = z * (1.0 + 0.10 * warm) + lift * 0.9
            elif ch == 1:
                z = z * (1.0 + 0.02 * warm) + lift * 1.0
            else:
                z = z * (1.0 - 0.10 * warm) + lift * 1.25
            z = 255.0 * z
            out[v] = 0 if z < 0 else (255 if z > 255 else int(z))
    return lr, lg, lb


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- render
class Renderer:
    def __init__(self, scene, title):
        self.s = scene
        self.title = title
        self.spr = SPRITES

    # camera
    def cam(self, t):
        z = 1.0 + 0.055 * ease_out(t / DUR)
        cx = W * 0.5 + 16.0 * math.sin(t * 0.22)
        cy = H * 0.5 + 10.0 * math.cos(t * 0.17)
        return z, cx, cy

    def project(self, x, y, cam):
        z, cx, cy = cam
        return (W * 0.5 + (x - W * 0.5) * z + (cx - W * 0.5) * 0.4,
                H * 0.5 + (y - H * 0.5) * z + (cy - H * 0.5) * 0.4)

    def node_state(self, n, t):
        flick = 0.90 + 0.10 * math.sin(t * n['fr'] * TAU + n['ph'])
        flick *= 0.94 + 0.12 * vnoise(t * 0.9 + n['ph'], n['id'] * 0.37, 5)
        if n['arr'] is None or t < n['arr']:
            return 0.0, 0.0
        u = t - n['arr']
        w = 1 - math.exp(-u / 0.16)
        flash = math.exp(-u / 0.30) * 0.55
        return w, flash

    def line(self, r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, f, k, col):
        dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
        n = int(max(abs(dx), abs(dy)))
        if n < 1:
            return
        cr, cg, cb = col
        for i in range(n + 1):
            u = i / n
            # only the part of the edge already reached
            if u > f:
                break
            x = int(x0 + dx * u)
            y = int(y0 + dy * u)
            if x < 1 or y < 1 or x >= W - 1 or y >= H - 1:
                continue
            o = y * W + x
            a = k * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(math.pi * min(1.0, u / max(f, 1e-6)))) if f < 1 else k
            vr = cr * a
            vg = cg * a
            vb = cb * a
            for oo in (0, 1, W):
                p = o + oo
                v = r[p] + vr
                r[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                v = g[p] + vg
                g[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                v = b[p] + vb
                b[p] = v if v < 255 else 255

    def render(self, t):
        r = bytearray(PLATE[0])
        g = bytearray(PLATE[1])
        b = bytearray(PLATE[2])
        cam = self.cam(t)
        z = cam[0]
        s = self.s

        # ---- edges (both the unlit skeleton and the lit threads)
        for e in s.edges:
            na, nb = s.nodes[e['a']], s.nodes[e['b']]
            x0, y0 = self.project(na['x'], na['y'], cam)
            x1, y1 = self.project(nb['x'], nb['y'], cam)
            dep = (na['dep'] + nb['dep']) * 0.5
            if e['t1'] is not None and t >= e['t0']:
                f = clamp((t - e['t0']) / max(1e-3, e['t1'] - e['t0']))
                if f >= 1.0:
                    # lit: warm thread, gently breathing
                    kk = 0.30 + 0.13 * dep
                    kk *= 0.92 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + e['a'])
                    self.line(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, 1.0, kk, (1.0, 0.56, 0.30))
                else:
                    # cold ghost, brightening as the spark approaches
                    self.line(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, f, 0.16 + 0.30 * dep,
                              (0.55, 0.66, 1.0))
            else:
                self.line(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, 1.0, 0.020 + 0.020 * dep,
                          (0.42, 0.58, 1.0))

        # ---- the first reach: a thread across the gap
        A, B = s.A, s.B
        ax, ay = self.project(A['x'], A['y'], cam)
        bx, by = self.project(B['x'], B['y'], cam)
        if t >= T_SHOOT:
            f = clamp((t - T_SHOOT) / (T_CATCH - T_SHOOT))
            f = ease_out(f)
            mx, my = (ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2
            nx, ny = -(by - ay), (bx - ax)
            L = math.hypot(nx, ny) or 1
            bow = 34.0
            cx, cy = mx + nx / L * bow, my + ny / L * bow
            # quadratic bezier samples
            pts = []
            for i in range(41):
                u = i / 40.0
                pts.append(((1 - u) ** 2 * ax + 2 * u * (1 - u) * cx + u * u * bx,
                            (1 - u) ** 2 * ay + 2 * u * (1 - u) * cy + u * u * by))
            m = int(f * 40)
            for i in range(m):
                (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
                self.line(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, 1.0,
                          0.85 if f < 1 else 0.42, (1.0, 0.70, 0.42))
            if f < 1:
                tx, ty = pts[m]
                blit(r, g, b, SPRARK, int(tx), int(ty), 0.95)
            elif t >= T_CATCH:
                # connection: it simply stays, a little brighter than the rest
                for i in range(40):
                    (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
                    self.line(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, 1.0, 0.34,
                              (1.0, 0.62, 0.34))

        # ---- the pulse at A before it reaches
        if T_PULSE <= t < T_PULSE + 1.0:
            u = (t - T_PULSE) / 1.0
            rad = 8 + 150 * ease_out(u)
            kk = 0.42 * (1 - u) ** 1.6
            self.ring(r, g, b, ax, ay, rad, kk, (0.80, 0.72, 1.0))

        # ---- burst at contact
        if t >= T_CATCH:
            u = t - T_CATCH
            if u < 1.25:
                rad = 14 + 320 * ease_out(u / 1.25)
                kk = 0.55 * (1 - u / 1.25) ** 1.8
                self.ring(r, g, b, (ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2, rad, kk,
                          (1.0, 0.66, 0.40))
            if u < 0.9:
                kk = (1 - u / 0.9) ** 2
                blit(r, g, b, SPRARK, int(ax), int(ay), kk * 1.4)

        # ---- the people
        post = max(0.0, (t - T_ALL) / 1.6)
        pulse = 0.0
        if post > 0:
            pulse = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos((t - T_ALL) * TAU / 2.7)
        for n in s.nodes:
            w, flash = self.node_state(n, t)
            flick = 0.92 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * n['fr'] * TAU + n['ph'])
            px, py = self.project(n['x'], n['y'], cam)
            cls = min(4, max(0, int(round((n['size'] - 0.62) / 0.85 * 4))))
            q = int(round(clamp(w) * SPR_Q))
            inten = (1.0 + flash) * n['br'] * flick
            if w > 0.001:
                inten *= 1.0 + 0.10 * pulse * post
            if n['root']:
                inten *= 1.22
            cold = 0.14 + 0.42 * (1.0 - w)
            if w < 0.02:
                cold *= 0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * n['fr'] * TAU + n['ph']) * 0.5 + 0.25
            blit(r, g, b, self.spr[(cls, q)], int(px), int(py), inten * (1.0 if w > 0.02 else 0.42))
            if w < 0.02:
                pass
        # ---- embers drifting up once the world is warm
        if t > T_ALL - 1.4:
            ea = clamp((t - (T_ALL - 1.4)) / 1.6)
            for i in range(46):
                ph = hash2(i, 3, 91)
                sp = 8 + 16 * hash2(i, 7, 13)
                x = (hash2(i, 11, 5) * W + t * (6 - 10 * ph)) % W
                y = H + 40 - (t * sp + ph * H * 1.6) % (H + 90)
                kk = ea * (0.30 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 1.7 + ph * 20))
                cls = 1
                blit(r, g, b, self.spr[(cls, 14)], int(x), int(y), kk)
        return r, g, b, cam

    def ring(self, r, g, b, cx, cy, rad, k, col):
        n = max(24, int(rad * 0.55))
        cr, cg, cb = col
        for i in range(n):
            a = i / n * TAU
            x = int(cx + math.cos(a) * rad)
            y = int(cy + math.sin(a) * rad)
            if x < 1 or y < 1 or x >= W - 1 or y >= H - 1:
                continue
            o = y * W + x
            for oo in (0, 1, W):
                p = o + oo
                v = r[p] + cr * k
                r[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                v = g[p] + cg * k
                g[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                v = b[p] + cb * k
                b[p] = v if v < 255 else 255


SPRARK = SPARK


def exposure_at(t):
    e = 1.0
    # gentle settle as the story lands
    if t > T_ALL:
        e -= 0.10 * smoothstep((t - T_ALL) / 1.6)
    e *= 1.0 - 0.10 * smoothstep((t - T_TITLE) / 1.2)
    # a touch of lift on the very last beat
    return e


def to_rgb(r, g, b, t):
    exp = exposure_at(t)
    warm = 0.55 + 0.45 * smoothstep((t - T_CATCH) / (T_ALL - T_CATCH))
    lift = 0.004
    lr, lg, lb = build_lut(exp, lift, warm)
    rr = bytes(r).translate(lr)
    gg = bytes(g).translate(lg)
    bb = bytes(b).translate(lb)
    out = bytearray(W * H * 3)
    out[0::3] = rr
    out[1::3] = gg
    out[2::3] = bb
    return out


def main():
    scene = Scene()
    scene.solve()
    title = Title('call someone.')
    ren = Renderer(scene, title)

    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if args and args[0] == 'stills':
        ts = [float(x) for x in args[1].split(',')]
        for t in ts:
            r, g, b, cam = ren.render(t)
            img = to_rgb(r, g, b, t)
            k = clamp((t - T_TITLE) / 1.3)
            if k > 0:
                title.stamp(img, k)
            write_png('still_%.2f.png' % t, W, H, img)
            print('still', t)
        return

    # video: raw rgb24 into ffmpeg
    out = args[0] if args else 'video_raw.mp4'
    cmd = ['ffmpeg', '-y', '-loglevel', 'error',
           '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb24', '-s', '%dx%d' % (W, H),
           '-r', str(FPS), '-i', '-',
           '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'slow', '-crf', '15',
           '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-movflags', '+faststart', out]
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
    for i in range(NF):

        img = to_rgb(r, g, b, t)
        k = clamp((t - T_TITLE) / 1.3)
        if k > 0:
            title.stamp(img, smoothstep(k))
        p.stdin.write(bytes(img))
        if i % 24 == 0:
            print('frame', i, '/', NF, flush=True)
    p.stdin.close()
    p.wait()
    print('done')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""call someone.  --  a 9.6 second animation.

A dark world made of hundreds of faint blue lights. One of them reaches out
across a gap. Warmth travels thread to thread, person to person, until there
is nowhere left in the frame that is cold.

Pure stdlib: additive light accumulation in 8-bit energy buffers, a filmic
tone curve baked into per-frame LUTs, raw rgb24 frames piped to ffmpeg.
"""
import heapq
import math
import random
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from font import TTF, text_polygons, rasterize
from pngutil import write_png

W, H = 1920, 1080
FPS = 30
DUR = 9.6
NF = int(round(DUR * FPS))

T_PULSE = 1.15      # A notices
T_SHOOT = 1.62      # the thread leaves A
T_CATCH = 2.32      # contact
T_ALL = 6.20        # the last light
T_TITLE = 7.45      # the words arrive

TAU = math.pi * 2
ENERGY = 96.0
SPR_Q = 20
SIZES = [7, 10, 14, 19, 26, 36, 50]


def clamp(x, a=0.0, b=1.0):
    return a if x < a else (b if x > b else x)


def smoothstep(x):
    x = clamp(x)
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)


def ease_out(x):
    x = clamp(x)
    return 1 - (1 - x) ** 3


def hash2(ix, iy, seed=0):
    n = (ix * 374761393 + iy * 668265263 + seed * 1442695040888963407) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    n = (n ^ (n >> 13)) * 1274126177 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return ((n ^ (n >> 16)) & 0xFFFFFF) / float(0xFFFFFF)


def vnoise(x, y, seed=0):
    ix, iy = math.floor(x), math.floor(y)
    fx, fy = x - ix, y - iy
    ux, uy = smoothstep(fx), smoothstep(fy)
    a = hash2(ix, iy, seed)
    b = hash2(ix + 1, iy, seed)
    c = hash2(ix, iy + 1, seed)
    d = hash2(ix + 1, iy + 1, seed)
    return (a * (1 - ux) + b * ux) * (1 - uy) + (c * (1 - ux) + d * ux) * uy


def fbm(x, y, seed=0, oct=3):
    s, amp, tot = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0
    for o in range(oct):
        s += amp * vnoise(x * (2 ** o), y * (2 ** o), seed + o * 17)
        tot += amp
        amp *= 0.5
    return s / tot


# -------------------------------------------------------------------- world
class World:
    """Lights = people.  'souls' carry threads; 'dust' is everyone further off."""

    def __init__(self, seed=11):
        rnd = random.Random(seed)

        # --- inhabited regions, drawn as loose clumps along soft filaments
        pts = []
        clumps = []
        for _ in range(11):
            cx = rnd.uniform(W * 0.02, W * 0.98)
            cy = rnd.uniform(-H * 0.06, H * 1.06)
            sx = rnd.uniform(70, 210)
            sy = rnd.uniform(60, 190)
            n = rnd.randint(14, 34)
            clumps.append((cx, cy, sx, sy, n))
        want = []
        for cx, cy, sx, sy, n in clumps:
            for _ in range(n):
                a = rnd.uniform(0, TAU)
                r = math.sqrt(rnd.random())
                want.append((cx + math.cos(a) * r * sx * 1.7,
                             cy + math.sin(a) * r * sy * 1.7))
        for _ in range(120):
            want.append((rnd.uniform(-50, W + 50), rnd.uniform(-50, H + 50)))
        rnd.shuffle(want)

        # --- souls: well separated, they are the ones we can follow
        souls = []
        for x, y in want:
            if len(souls) >= 62:
                break
            if abs(x - W * 0.5) < 300 and abs(y - H * 0.855) < 110:
                continue
            ok = True
            for p in souls:
                if (p['x'] - x) ** 2 + (p['y'] - y) ** 2 < 150 ** 2:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                souls.append(self._mk(rnd, x, y, 'soul'))
        # --- dust: everything else, everywhere
        dust = []
        for x, y in want:
            if len(dust) >= 430:
                break
            if abs(x - W * 0.5) < 260 and abs(y - H * 0.855) < 95:
                continue
            ok = True
            for p in dust:
                if (p['x'] - x) ** 2 + (p['y'] - y) ** 2 < 40 ** 2:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                dust.append(self._mk(rnd, x, y, 'dust'))
        self.souls = souls
        self.dust = dust
        self.nodes = souls + dust

        # --- threads between souls: a loose web of acquaintance
        N = len(souls)
        eset = set()
        for i, a in enumerate(souls):
            d = sorted(((math.hypot(a['x'] - b['x'], a['y'] - b['y']), j)
                        for j, b in enumerate(souls) if j != i))
            for dd, j in d[:3]:
                if dd < 430:
                    eset.add((min(i, j), max(i, j)))
        parent = list(range(N))

        def find(a):
            while parent[a] != a:
                parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]
                a = parent[a]
            return a

        for a, b in eset:
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra != rb:
                parent[ra] = rb
        comps = {}
        for i in range(N):
            comps.setdefault(find(i), []).append(i)
        if len(comps) > 1:
            reps = [c[0] for c in comps.values()]
            for k in range(1, len(reps)):
                best = None
                for u in reps[:k]:
                    for v in reps[k:]:
                        dd = math.hypot(souls[u]['x'] - souls[v]['x'],
                                        souls[u]['y'] - souls[v]['y'])
                        if best is None or dd < best[0]:
                            best = (dd, u, v)
                eset.add((min(best[1], best[2]), max(best[1], best[2])))

        self.edges = []
        for a, b in sorted(eset):
            na, nb = souls[a], souls[b]
            L = math.hypot(na['x'] - nb['x'], na['y'] - nb['y'])
            self.edges.append({'a': a, 'b': b, 'L': L,
                               'jit': rnd.uniform(0.86, 1.20),
                               'bow': rnd.uniform(-0.13, 0.13) * L,
                               't0': None, 't1': None})
        self._pick_origin(rnd)
        self._solve(rnd)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    def _mk(self, rnd, x, y, kind):
        dep = clamp((fbm(x / 560.0, y / 560.0, seed=3, oct=3) - 0.28) / 0.46)
        if kind == 'soul':
            cls = 4 + (1 if rnd.random() < 0.55 + 0.4 * dep else 0)
        else:
            cls = int(clamp(round(1.2 + 2.2 * dep + rnd.uniform(-0.7, 0.7)), 0, 3))
        return {
            'x': x, 'y': y, 'kind': kind, 'dep': dep, 'cls': cls,
            'br': 0.55 + 0.55 * dep,
            'ph': rnd.uniform(0, TAU),
            'fr': rnd.uniform(0.18, 0.5),
            'arr': 0.0, 'root': False,
        }

    def _pick_origin(self, rnd):
        target = (W * 0.38, H * 0.44)
        A = min(self.souls, key=lambda n: math.hypot(n['x'] - target[0], n['y'] - target[1]))
        cands = []
        for n in self.souls:
            if n is A:
                continue
            d = math.hypot(n['x'] - A['x'], n['y'] - A['y'])
            if 230 < d < 420:
                cands.append((abs(d - 330), n))
        cands.sort(key=lambda c: c[0])
        B = cands[0][1]
        self.A, self.B = A, B
        A['root'] = True
        B['root'] = True

    def _solve(self, rnd):
        A, B = self.A, self.B
        idx = {id(n): i for i, n in enumerate(self.souls)}
        rank = {i: n for i, n in enumerate(self.souls)}
        adj = {i: [] for i in range(len(self.souls))}
        for e in self.edges:
            adj[e['a']].append((e['b'], e))
            adj[e['b']].append((e['a'], e))
        SPEED = 660.0
        dist = {}
        prev = {}
        pq = []
        for r in (A, B):
            i = idx[id(r)]
            dist[i] = T_CATCH
            heapq.heappush(pq, (T_CATCH, i))
        while pq:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if d > dist.get(u, 1e9) + 1e-9:
                continue
            for v, e in adj[u]:
                nd = d + e['L'] / SPEED * e['jit']
                if nd < dist.get(v, 1e9):
                    dist[v] = nd
                    prev[v] = (u, e)
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v))
        mx = max(dist.values())
        k = (T_ALL - T_CATCH) / (mx - T_CATCH)
        for i, d in dist.items():
            rank[i]['arr'] = T_CATCH + (d - T_CATCH) * k
        for v, (u, e) in prev.items():
            e['t1'] = self.souls[v]['arr']
            e['t0'] = max(T_CATCH - 0.45, e['t1'] - (e['L'] / SPEED * e['jit']) * k)
        for e in self.edges:
            if e['t1'] is None:
                e['t1'] = max(self.souls[e['a']]['arr'], self.souls[e['b']]['arr'])
                e['t0'] = e['t1'] - 0.28
        self.origin = ((A['x'] + B['x']) / 2, (A['y'] + B['y']) / 2)

        # dust lights when its neighbourhood lights: inverse-distance blend
        # of nearby soul arrival times, with a little local weather.
        sx = [(n['x'], n['y'], n['arr']) for n in self.souls]
        for i, n in enumerate(self.dust):
            best = sorted(((math.hypot(n['x'] - x, n['y'] - y), a) for x, y, a in sx))[:7]
            num = den = 0.0
            for d, a in best:
                w = 1.0 / (d * d + 400.0)
                num += a * w
                den += w
            base = num / den
            wob = (fbm(n['x'] / 210.0, n['y'] / 210.0, seed=41, oct=2) - 0.5) * 0.55
            n['arr'] = clamp(base + wob + rnd.uniform(-0.09, 0.09), T_CATCH, T_ALL)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ sprites
def build_sprites():
    COOL = (0.16, 0.42, 1.00)
    WARM = (1.00, 0.52, 0.20)
    out = {}
    for cls, R in enumerate(SIZES):
        hot_scale = 1.0 if R > 18 else 0.35
        for q in range(SPR_Q + 1):
            f = q / SPR_Q
            px = []
            for dy in range(-R, R + 1):
                for dx in range(-R, R + 1):
                    u2 = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / float(R * R)
                    if u2 > 1.0:
                        continue
                    u = math.sqrt(u2)
                    core = math.exp(-(u / 0.16) ** 2)
                    halo = math.exp(-(u / 0.42) ** 2)
                    wide = math.exp(-(u / 0.90) ** 2)
                    amp = 0.60 * core + 0.24 * halo + 0.12 * wide
                    amp *= (1.0 - u * u) ** 0.7
                    cr = amp * ((1 - f) * COOL[0] + f * WARM[0])
                    cg = amp * ((1 - f) * COOL[1] + f * WARM[1])
                    cb = amp * ((1 - f) * COOL[2] + f * WARM[2])
                    h = f * math.exp(-(u / 0.11) ** 2) * 1.0 * hot_scale
                    cr += h
                    cg += h
                    cb += h * 0.96
                    px.append((dy * W + dx, int(cr * ENERGY + 0.5),
                               int(cg * ENERGY + 0.5), int(cb * ENERGY + 0.5)))
            offs = [p[0] for p in px]
            out[(cls, q)] = (px, min(offs), max(offs))
    return out


SPRITES = build_sprites()


def _spark():
    px = []
    for dy in range(-13, 14):
        for dx in range(-13, 14):
            u2 = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / 169.0
            if u2 <= 1:
                a = math.exp(-u2 * 3.2) * (1 - u2) ** 0.6 * ENERGY * 1.9
                px.append((dy * W + dx, int(a), int(a * 0.70), int(a * 0.44)))
    offs = [p[0] for p in px]
    return (px, min(offs), max(offs))


SPARK = _spark()


def blit(r, g, b, sprite, cx, cy, k):
    px, lo, hi = sprite
    if cx < 0 or cy < 0 or cx >= W or cy >= H:
        return
    base = cy * W + cx
    if base + lo < 0 or base + hi >= W * H:
        return
    if k >= 0.999:
        for off, wr, wg, wb in px:
            i = base + off
            v = r[i] + wr
            r[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = g[i] + wg
            g[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = b[i] + wb
            b[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
    else:
        for off, wr, wg, wb in px:
            i = base + off
            v = r[i] + int(wr * k + 0.5)
            r[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = g[i] + int(wg * k + 0.5)
            g[i] = v if v < 255 else 255
            v = b[i] + int(wb * k + 0.5)
            b[i] = v if v < 255 else 255


# --------------------------------------------------------------- base plate
def build_plate():
    r = bytearray(W * H)
    g = bytearray(W * H)
    b = bytearray(W * H)
    for y in range(H):
        t = y / (H - 1.0)
        for x in range(W):
            n = fbm(x / 430.0, y / 430.0, seed=11, oct=3)
            n2 = fbm(x / 120.0, y / 120.0, seed=29, oct=2)
            v = 1.1 + 5.0 * (t ** 2.2) + 4.6 * (n ** 2.2) + 1.2 * n2
            i = y * W + x
            r[i] = int(v * 0.60)
            g[i] = int(v * 0.78)
            b[i] = int(v * 1.32)
    return r, g, b


PLATE = build_plate()


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- text
class Title:
    def __init__(self, text, path='/System/Library/Fonts/Avenir.ttc', index=6,
                 target_w=780, baseline=0.215):
        f = TTF(path, index)
        polys, adv, _ = text_polygons(f, text, tracking=f.unitsPerEm * 0.055)
        scale = adv / float(target_w)
        xs = [x for p in polys for x, _ in p]
        ys = [y for p in polys for _, y in p]
        oy = H * (1 - baseline)
        ox = W / 2.0 - (min(xs) + max(xs)) / 2.0 / scale
        pad = 30
        self.y0 = max(0, int(oy - max(ys) / scale) - pad)
        self.y1 = min(H, int(oy - min(ys) / scale) + pad)
        cov = rasterize(polys, W, self.y1 - self.y0, ox, oy - self.y0, scale, ss=3)
        self.n = len(cov)
        self.steps = []
        for s in range(33):
            k = s / 32.0
            lay = bytearray(self.n)
            for i in range(self.n):
                c = cov[i]
                if c:
                    lay[i] = int(c * k)
            self.steps.append(lay)

    def stamp(self, img, k):
        s = int(round(clamp(k) * 32))
        if s <= 0:
            return
        lay = self.steps[s]
        hh = self.y1 - self.y0
        for yy in range(hh):
            row = (self.y0 + yy) * W
            lo = yy * W
            for x in range(W):
                c = lay[lo + x]
                if c:
                    p = (row + x) * 3
                    v = img[p] + c
                    img[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                    v = img[p + 1] + int(c * 0.96)
                    img[p + 1] = v if v < 255 else 255
                    v = img[p + 2] + int(c * 0.88)
                    img[p + 2] = v if v < 255 else 255


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tone curve
def build_lut(exposure, warm):
    lr = bytearray(256)
    lg = bytearray(256)
    lb = bytearray(256)
    for v in range(256):
        x = v / 255.0
        y = 1.0 - math.exp(-x * 2.75)
        y = y ** 0.90 * exposure
        z = 255.0 * (y * (1.0 + 0.08 * warm) + 0.002)
        lr[v] = 0 if z < 0 else (255 if z > 255 else int(z))
        z = 255.0 * (y * (1.0 + 0.01 * warm) + 0.002)
        lg[v] = 0 if z < 0 else (255 if z > 255 else int(z))
        z = 255.0 * (y * (1.0 - 0.06 * warm) + 0.003)
        lb[v] = 0 if z < 0 else (255 if z > 255 else int(z))
    return lr, lg, lb


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- render
class Renderer:
    def __init__(self, world, title):
        self.w = world
        self.title = title

    def cam(self, t):
        z = 1.0 + 0.05 * ease_out(t / DUR)
        return (z, W * 0.5 + 14.0 * math.sin(t * 0.21),
                H * 0.5 + 9.0 * math.cos(t * 0.16))

    def project(self, x, y, cam):
        z, cx, cy = cam
        return (W * 0.5 + (x - W * 0.5) * z + (cx - W * 0.5) * 0.5 * z,
                H * 0.5 + (y - H * 0.5) * z + (cy - H * 0.5) * 0.5 * z)

    def thread(self, r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, frac, k, col, bow, taper=True):
        dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
        L = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
        nx, ny = -dy / L, dx / L
        cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 + nx * bow
        cy = (y0 + y1) / 2 + ny * bow
        n = max(2, int(L))
        lim = int(frac * n)
        vr = int(col[0] * k + 0.5)
        vg = int(col[1] * k + 0.5)
        vb = int(col[2] * k + 0.5)
        if vr == vg == vb == 0:
            return
        for i in range(lim + 1):
            u = i / n
            x = int((1 - u) ** 2 * x0 + 2 * u * (1 - u) * cx + u * u * x1)
            y = int((1 - u) ** 2 * y0 + 2 * u * (1 - u) * cy + u * u * y1)
            if x < 1 or y < 1 or x >= W - 1 or y >= H - 1:
                continue
            f = 1.0
            if taper:
                f = 0.30 + 0.70 * min(1.0, u * 7.0, (1.0 - u) * 7.0)
            o = y * W + x
            for oo, ww in ((0, 1.0), (W, 0.75)):
                p = o + oo
                ar = int(vr * f * ww)
                ag = int(vg * f * ww)
                ab = int(vb * f * ww)
                if ar:
                    v = r[p] + ar
                    r[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                if ag:
                    v = g[p] + ag
                    g[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                if ab:
                    v = b[p] + ab
                    b[p] = v if v < 255 else 255

    def ring(self, r, g, b, cx, cy, rad, k, col):
        n = max(28, int(rad * 0.7))
        dr = int(col[0] * k * 80 + 0.5)
        dg = int(col[1] * k * 80 + 0.5)
        db = int(col[2] * k * 80 + 0.5)
        for i in range(n):
            a = i / n * TAU
            x = int(cx + math.cos(a) * rad)
            y = int(cy + math.sin(a) * rad)
            if x < 1 or y < 1 or x >= W - 1 or y >= H - 1:
                continue
            o = y * W + x
            for oo in (0, 1, W):
                p = o + oo
                v = r[p] + dr
                r[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                v = g[p] + dg
                g[p] = v if v < 255 else 255
                v = b[p] + db
                b[p] = v if v < 255 else 255

    def render(self, t):
        r = bytearray(PLATE[0])
        g = bytearray(PLATE[1])
        b = bytearray(PLATE[2])
        cam = self.cam(t)
        wd = self.w

        # ---------- the web between the souls
        for e in wd.edges:
            na, nb = wd.souls[e['a']], wd.souls[e['b']]
            x0, y0 = self.project(na['x'], na['y'], cam)
            x1, y1 = self.project(nb['x'], nb['y'], cam)
            dep = (na['dep'] + nb['dep']) * 0.5
            bow = e['bow'] * cam[0]
            if t >= e['t0']:
                f = clamp((t - e['t0']) / max(1e-3, e['t1'] - e['t0']))
                if f >= 1.0:
                    kk = 4.2 + 3.4 * dep
                    kk *= 0.88 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + e['a'] * 1.7)
                    self.thread(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, 1.0, kk,
                                (1.0, 0.44, 0.20), bow)
                else:
                    self.thread(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, f, 13.0 + 7.0 * dep,
                                (1.0, 0.76, 0.60), bow)
            else:
                self.thread(r, g, b, x0, y0, x1, y1, 1.0, 1.9 + 2.0 * dep,
                            (0.38, 0.54, 1.0), bow, taper=False)

        # ---------- the first reach
        A, B = wd.A, wd.B
        ax, ay = self.project(A['x'], A['y'], cam)
        bx, by = self.project(B['x'], B['y'], cam)
        if t >= T_SHOOT:
            f = ease_out((t - T_SHOOT) / (T_CATCH - T_SHOOT))
            L = math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay) or 1.0
            nx, ny = -(by - ay) / L, (bx - ax) / L
            bow = 30.0 * cam[0]
            mx = (ax + bx) / 2 + nx * bow
            my = (ay + by) / 2 + ny * bow
            self.thread(r, g, b, ax, ay, bx, by, f,
                        34.0 if f < 1 else 9.0, (1.0, 0.62, 0.34), bow,
                        taper=False)
            if f < 1:
                u = f
                tx = (1 - u) ** 2 * ax + 2 * u * (1 - u) * mx + u * u * bx
                ty = (1 - u) ** 2 * ay + 2 * u * (1 - u) * my + u * u * by
                blit(r, g, b, SPARK, int(tx), int(ty), 1.0)

        # ---------- A's small pulse before the reach
        if T_PULSE <= t < T_PULSE + 1.05:
            u = (t - T_PULSE) / 1.05
            self.ring(r, g, b, ax, ay, 6 + 130 * ease_out(u),
                      0.5 * (1 - u) ** 1.7, (0.85, 0.78, 1.0))

        # ---------- contact
        if t >= T_CATCH:
            u = t - T_CATCH
            if u < 1.3:
                self.ring(r, g, b, (ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2,
                          12 + 330 * ease_out(u / 1.3),
                          0.55 * (1 - u / 1.3) ** 1.8, (1.0, 0.64, 0.38))
            if u < 1.0:
                blit(r, g, b, SPARK, int(ax), int(ay), (1 - u) ** 2 * 1.3)

        # ---------- everyone
        post = clamp((t - T_ALL) / 1.6)
        pulse = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos((t - T_ALL) * TAU / 2.7) if post > 0 else 0.0
        for n in wd.nodes:
            tt = t - n['arr']
            if tt <= 0:
                w = 0.0
                flash = 0.0
            else:
                w = 1 - math.exp(-tt / 0.17)
                flash = math.exp(-tt / 0.32) * 0.55
            flick = 0.90 + 0.10 * math.sin(t * n['fr'] * TAU + n['ph'])
            px, py = self.project(n['x'], n['y'], cam)
            q = int(round(clamp(w) * SPR_Q))
            inten = (1.0 + flash) * n['br'] * flick
            if w > 0.001:
                inten *= 1.0 + 0.12 * pulse * post
            if n['root']:
                inten *= 1.25
            cold = 0.30 if n['kind'] == 'soul' else 0.55
            k = inten * (cold + (1 - cold) * min(1.0, w * 4.0))
            blit(r, g, b, SPRITES[(n['cls'], q)], int(px), int(py), k)

        # ---------- embers
        if t > T_ALL - 1.9:
            ea = clamp((t - (T_ALL - 1.9)) / 1.9)
            for i in range(70):
                ph = hash2(i, 3, 91)
                sp = 10 + 22 * hash2(i, 7, 13)
                x = (hash2(i, 11, 5) * W * 1.1 + t * (7 - 12 * ph)) % W
                y = H + 30 - (t * sp + ph * H * 1.8) % (H + 70)
                kk = ea * (0.20 + 0.16 * math.sin(t * 1.9 + ph * 21))
                blit(r, g, b, SPRITES[(1, 13)], int(x), int(y), kk)
        return r, g, b, cam


def exposure_at(t):
    e = 1.0
    if t > T_ALL:
        e -= 0.06 * smoothstep((t - T_ALL) / 1.6)
    e *= 1.0 - 0.09 * smoothstep((t - T_TITLE) / 1.3)
    return e


def to_rgb(r, g, b, t):
    exp = exposure_at(t)
    warm = 0.45 + 0.55 * smoothstep((t - T_CATCH) / (T_ALL - T_CATCH))
    lr, lg, lb = build_lut(exp, warm)
    out = bytearray(W * H * 3)
    out[0::3] = bytes(r).translate(lr)
    out[1::3] = bytes(g).translate(lg)
    out[2::3] = bytes(b).translate(lb)
    return out


def main():
    world = World()
    title = Title('call someone.')
    ren = Renderer(world, title)
    args = sys.argv[1:]

    if args and args[0] == 'stills':
        for t in [float(x) for x in args[1].split(',')]:
            r, g, b, cam = ren.render(t)
            img = to_rgb(r, g, b, t)
            k = clamp((t - T_TITLE) / 1.3)
            if k > 0:
                title.stamp(img, smoothstep(k))
            write_png('still_%.2f.png' % t, W, H, img)
            print('still', t)
        return

    out = args[0] if args else 'video_raw.mp4'
    cmd = ['ffmpeg', '-y', '-loglevel', 'error',
           '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb24', '-s', '%dx%d' % (W, H),
           '-r', str(FPS), '-i', '-',
           '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'slow', '-crf', '14',
           '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-movflags', '+faststart', out]
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
    for i in range(NF):
        t = i / FPS
        r, g, b, cam = ren.render(t)
        img = to_rgb(r, g, b, t)
        k = clamp((t - T_TITLE) / 1.3)
        if k > 0:
            title.stamp(img, smoothstep(k))
        p.stdin.write(bytes(img))
        if i % 30 == 0:
            print('frame', i, '/', NF, flush=True)
    p.stdin.close()
    p.wait()
    print('done')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import zlib, struct
def readpng(path):
    d=open(path,'rb').read()
    # crude: parse IHDR + IDAT
    i=8; w=h=None; idat=b''
    while i < len(d):
        ln=struct.unpack('>I',d[i:i+4])[0]; tag=d[i+4:i+8]; data=d[i+8:i+8+ln]
        if tag==b'IHDR': w,h=struct.unpack('>II',data[:8]); bd,ct=data[8],data[9]

    # filter 0 rows assumed by our writer

import zlib, struct, glob
def readpng(path):
    d=open(path,'rb').read(); i=8; idat=b''
    while i < len(d):
        ln=struct.unpack('>I',d[i:i+4])[0]; tag=d[i+4:i+8]; data=d[i+8:i+8+ln]

    raw=zlib.decompress(idat); stride=w*3; px=bytearray()

    return w,h,px

#!/bin/bash
# Build "call someone." end to end.
#   1. render the light field (python, stdlib only) -> build.mp4 + amb/*.png
#   2. grade: warm haze + two-scale bloom + vignette + grain
#   3. title cards
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
mkdir -p output tmp

echo "== render =="
rm -rf amb
python3 src/art.py build.mp4

BLUR_MAIN="\
[1:v]scale=1920:1080:flags=bicubic,fps=30,format=rgb24[amb];\
[0:v]format=rgb24[main];\
[main][amb]blend=all_mode=addition:all_opacity=1.0[base];\
[base]split=3[f][g1][g2];\
[g1]lutrgb=r='clip((val-70)*2.2,0,255)':g='clip((val-70)*2.2,0,255)':b='clip((val-70)*2.2,0,255)',gblur=sigma=9[b1];\
[g2]lutrgb=r='clip((val-55)*1.9,0,255)':g='clip((val-55)*1.9,0,255)':b='clip((val-55)*1.9,0,255)',gblur=sigma=38[b2];\
[f][b1]blend=all_mode=addition:all_opacity=0.8:shortest=1[c1];\
[c1][b2]blend=all_mode=addition:all_opacity=0.8:shortest=1[c2];\
[c2]format=rgb24,vignette=angle=PI/3.7,noise=alls=3:allf=t+u"

echo "== grade video =="
ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i build.mp4 -f image2 -i amb/%04d.png \
  -filter_complex "$BLUR_MAIN" \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart \
  output/call_someone.mp4

echo "== stills =="
python3 src/art.py stills 2.05,8.40 >/dev/null
for t in 2.05 8.40; do
  n=$(printf "%03d" $(( ${t%.*} * 30 + 0 )) )
  :
done
ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i still_2.05.png -f image2 -i amb/0061.png \
  -filter_complex "${BLUR_MAIN/\[main\]/\[main\]}" -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 tmp/poster1.jpg
ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i still_8.40.png -f image2 -i amb/0252.png \
  -filter_complex "${BLUR_MAIN}" -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 tmp/poster2.jpg

cp tmp/poster1.jpg output/call_someone_reach.jpg
cp tmp/poster2.jpg output/call_someone_title.jpg

ls -la output/

arguments.content:
# call someone.

A 9.6-second animation about the cheapest, most universal, most evidence-backed
intervention there is: reaching out to another person.

## The idea

Almost every human on earth can do one thing today that measurably improves
their life and someone else's, costs nothing, needs no infrastructure, no
permission, no money, and scales to everyone: **contact with another person**.
Social connection is one of the strongest known predictors of health and
longevity; isolation is as harmful as smoking. It is also contagious in the
good direction — warmth passed to one person tends to travel on.

So the film reduces the world to its smallest true picture: a dark field of
faint blue lights, one for each of us. Threads between them are already there —
we just cannot see them lit. One light reaches across a gap. The thread catches,
a spark crosses, and warmth runs person to person until there is nowhere left
in the frame that is cold. The world does not become different; it becomes warm.
Then the only lines in the film arrive:

> **call someone.**

No narration, no statistics, no language in the picture until the last second —
so the image can work for anyone, and the invitation is one everybody can
accept before the credits would have rolled.

## Structure (9.6 s, 30 fps, 1920×1080)

| time | beat |
|---|---|
| 0.0–1.1 | a cold world: hundreds of faint blue lights, half-visible threads, slow breathing |
| 1.15 | one light pulses — it notices |
| 1.6–2.3 | a warm thread reaches across the gap, a spark at its tip |
| 2.32 | contact: a breath of light expands, two lights flare and settle into warmth |
| 2.3–6.2 | warmth spreads outward through the web, spark to spark, cold blue retreating to the edges |
| 5.9 | the light nearest to us — the one bottom-right — catches and floods the frame |
| 6.2–9.6 | the whole field is warm, breathing together; the world settles down to listen |
| 7.45–9.6 | the words arrive |

## Files

- `output/call_someone.mp4` — the film (1080p, 9.6 s, 1.2 MB)
- `output/call_someone_reach.jpg` — the reach (2.05 s)
- `output/call_someone_spreading.jpg` — the warmth travelling (3.50 s)
- `output/call_someone_title.jpg` — the title card (8.40 s)

## How it is made

Everything is generated from scratch with the Python standard library and
ffmpeg — no packages, no assets, no images downloaded. That constraint shapes
the whole pipeline:

- **`src/art.py`** — the world and the renderer.
  - ~75 "souls" (well-separated lights that carry the visible threads, k-nearest
    neighbours, connected), ~260 "dust" (everyone further off), and one hero
    light in the near field.
  - Light is accumulated additively into three 8-bit *energy* buffers per frame
    (byte saturation, no float framebuffers), then pushed through a per-frame
    filmic tone curve baked into a 256-entry LUT — so exposure, warm tint and
    the final "settle" are one C-speed `bytes.translate` per channel.
  - Glows are pre-computed sprites quantised by warmth (20 steps × 7 sizes), so
    cold → warm is a cross-fade of two light sources rather than a colour swap.
  - Arrival times form a noisy, organic front expanding from the point of
    contact; a spark is animated along each thread when both of its ends light.
  - A coarse 120×68 warm-haze field is rendered per frame (the air itself
    warming) and upscaled in ffmpeg.
- **`src/font.py`** — a minimal TrueType reader (`.ttc` aware, `cmap` 4/12,
  quadratic `glyf` outlines) plus an antialiased scanline rasteriser, because
  this ffmpeg has no `drawtext`. The title is set in Avenir Light, letter-spaced
  and drawn in the same additive light as everything else.
- **`src/pngutil.py`** — PNG writer (only used for inspection frames / the haze).
- **`src/make.sh`** — the whole build: render → grade → the three cards.
  The grade adds the warm haze layer, a two-scale highlight bloom, a vignette
  and fine grain, all in ffmpeg.
- **`src/grade.sh`** — the same look applied to a single still, for checking.

Rebuild everything (about a minute):

```sh
bash src/make.sh
```

Done. Here's what I made.

## `call someone.` — a 9.6 s, 1080p animation

**The pick:** if literally everyone watched one thing, the highest-leverage, most universal, zero-cost action available to every human is *contact with another person* — one of the strongest known predictors of health, longevity and happiness, free, requires no infrastructure and no authority, and it spreads. So the film is that action, shown wordlessly.

**The film:** a dark world of a few hundred faint blue lights — one per person — already joined by threads nobody can see lit. One light pulses. A warm thread reaches across a gap and a spark crosses. Contact: a breath of light expands, two lights flare. Then warmth runs spark-to-spark through the web, cold blue retreating to the edges, until the light nearest to us catches and floods the frame. The world isn't different — it's warm. Then the only words in the film: **call someone.**

**Craft notes** (stdlib + ffmpeg only, no packages, nothing downloaded):
- Custom additive **light-energy renderer**: byte-saturating energy buffers, per-frame filmic tone curve baked into 256-entry LUTs (so exposure, warm tint and the final "settle" are one C-speed `bytes.translate`), glows as warmth-quantised sprites so cold→warm cross-fades light rather than colour.
- Arrival times form a noisy organic front from the contact point; sparks run along each thread.
- A coarse **warm-haze field** per frame (the air itself heating) upscaled in ffmpeg, then two-scale highlight bloom, vignette, grain.
- This ffmpeg has no `drawtext`, so I wrote a **minimal TrueType reader + antialiased rasteriser** (`src/font.py`); the title is Avenir Light, letter-spaced, drifting up into place.

**Files** (`./output/`, all under 2 MB): `call_someone.mp4` (1.2 MB), plus three 1920×1080 cards — `_reach`, `_spreading`, `_title`. Source in `./src/` (`art.py`, `font.py`, `pngutil.py`, `make.sh`, `grade.sh`) with `README.md`; rebuild with `bash src/make.sh` (~1 min). Intermediates removed.
